topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Rain's been falling steady, same as my thoughts, since she told me. The city's a blur of headlights and rushing water, all blending together just like the last time we talked. She's moving, across the country, starting over. New job, new chapter, that kind of thing. I keep replaying our conversations, trying to find the moment it all slipped away. Maybe it was always this way, with the end hidden in plain sight. Now, I'm just left here, staring at the wet streets, wondering when the rain will let up, and if I'll see her again before she's just another memory fading into the mist.
